title: md.news.v1
description: Economic-calendar / news event, market-data view. Normalized from the existing master_economic_calendar_*.csv shape. UTC only. Carries the blackout window so consumers derive session/news restrictions consistently. This contract describes the DATA only; it expresses no execution policy.

currency.description: ISO-4217 currency the event affects (e.g. USD). For FUTURES later, this maps to the instrument's reference currency/region.

impact.description: Event impact classification from the calendar source.

blackout_before_s.description: Seconds before ts that constitute the pre-event blackout window.

blackout_after_s.description: Seconds after ts that constitute the post-event blackout window.

source.description: 'calendar' = historical CSV import; 'live' = live calendar feed; 'manual' = hand-entered.
